textes.Par lettre recommandée, remise en main p: By registered letter, hand delivery or a bailiff's notice (acte de commissaire de justice). Notice is 3 months for an unfurnished let, 1 month for a furnished one, in a high-demand area or in cases set out by law (job transfer, job loss, health reasons…).
textes.Réserver le déménageur ou l'utilitaire: Book the removal firm or van
textes.Plusieurs devis, surtout en fin de mois: Get several quotes, especially at the end of the month and in summer. For employees, some collective agreements grant a day off for moving house.
textes.Contrat de réexpédition de La Poste, à s: La Poste mail redirection contract: take it out about two weeks beforehand, for 6 or 12 months.
textes.Électricité et gaz : résilier ou transfé: Electricity and gas: cancel or transfer
textes.Prévenez le fournisseur du départ et ouv: Tell your supplier you are leaving and open the meter at the new home in your name. Read the meters on the day itself, at both homes.
textes.Le transfert de ligne prend souvent deux: Transferring a line often takes two to three weeks. If the service isn't available at the new address, you can cancel free of charge with proof.
textes.Le locataire doit être assuré dès la rem: The tenant must be insured from the moment the keys are handed over. Moving house lets you cancel the old contract; after one year of cover, you can cancel at any time anyway.
textes.État des lieux de sortie dans l'ancien l: Check-out inventory at the old home, check-in at the new one, with photos. Note the water, electricity and gas meter readings.
textes.Changer d'adresse auprès des administrat: Change your address with the authorities
textes.Un seul formulaire en ligne pour la CAF,: One online form for the CAF, the tax office, Assurance maladie, pension funds, France Travail and partner energy suppliers.
textes.Déclarer un changement de coordonnées: Report a change of contact details
textes.Banque, mutuelle, employeur, abonnements: Bank, top-up health insurance, employer, subscriptions: new address
textes.Lucien prépare le courrier de changement: Lucien prepares the change-of-address letter for each contract in your papers.
textes.Obligatoire dans le mois qui suit le dém: Compulsory within one month of moving, free, online on the ANTS website.
textes.Inscription en mairie de la nouvelle com: Register at the town hall of the new municipality, then apply for admission to the school. Lucien prepares the file.
textes.Dans la nouvelle commune, en ligne. Poss: In the new municipality, online. Possible all year round, up to the sixth Friday before an election.
textes.Le bailleur a un mois après la remise de: The landlord has one month after the keys are returned if the check-out inventory matches the check-in, two months otherwise. After that, they owe 10% of the rent per month of delay.
textes.Déclaration, CAF, Assurance maladie, mut: Declaration, CAF, Assurance maladie, top-up health insurance, leave and childcare.
textes.Avant la fin du troisième mois (14e sema: Before the end of the third month (week 14) to the CAF and Assurance maladie: the doctor or midwife sends it online.
textes.Crèche, assistante maternelle : les insc: Nursery, childminder: registration often starts during pregnancy. The monenfant.fr site lists places near you.
textes.En mairie, avant la naissance, pour étab: At the town hall, before the birth, to establish the father's parentage. It can also be done when the birth is registered.
textes.Congé de maternité, et congé de paternit: Maternity leave, and 25 days of paternity and childcare leave (4 of which must be taken straight after the birth): tell your employer one month ahead for the remaining part.
textes.Déclarer la naissance en mairie: Register the birth at the town hall
textes.Dans les 5 jours qui suivent l'accouchem: Within 5 days of the delivery, at the town hall of the place of birth (often possible at the maternity ward). Without this declaration, the birth certificate cannot be drawn up.
textes.Rattacher l'enfant à l'Assurance maladie: Add your child to Assurance maladie
textes.Dans votre compte ameli, avec l'acte de: In your ameli account, with the birth certificate, so they are covered on the Carte Vitale of one or both parents.
textes.Ajouter l'enfant à la mutuelle: Add your child to your top-up health insurance
textes.Avec l'acte de naissance, pour qu'il soi: With the birth certificate, so they are covered from their very first care.
textes.Déclarez la naissance dans votre espace: Declare the birth in your CAF account: allowances and the early childhood benefit (prestation d'accueil du jeune enfant).
textes.Signalez la naissance dans les 60 jours: Report the birth within 60 days in “Gérer mon prélèvement à la source” (manage your withholding tax) to lower your rate straight away.
textes.Sa page, ses papiers et ses dates clés :: Their page, papers and key dates: vaccinations, enrolments, benefits.
textes.Impôts, CAF, mutuelle, banque et assuran: Tax, CAF, top-up health insurance, bank and insurance to update.
textes.Date du mariage ou du PACS: Date of the marriage or PACS
textes.Mariage : dossier en mairie, avec public: Marriage: application at the town hall, with publication of the banns. PACS: at the town hall or with a notary, by appointment.
textes.Impôts : déclarer le changement dans les: Tax: report the change within 60 days
textes.Dans « Gérer mon prélèvement à la source: In “Gérer mon prélèvement à la source” (manage your withholding tax). Joint taxation from the year of the marriage or PACS; a separate return remains possible that year.
textes.Informer la CAF et l'Assurance maladie: Inform the CAF and Assurance maladie
textes.Le changement de situation peut modifier: The change in situation may alter your benefits (APL, prime d'activité).
textes.Mutuelle et assurances : regrouper ?: Top-up health insurance and insurance: combine?
textes.Un contrat famille revient souvent moins: A family policy is often cheaper than two separate ones. Home and car insurance can also be combined.
textes.Pour la mutuelle d'entreprise, et le con: For company top-up health insurance, and marriage or PACS leave (4 days).
textes.Compte joint, procurations, et bénéficia: Joint account, powers of attorney, and life insurance beneficiaries to review.
textes.Le nom d'usage figure sur les nouveaux p: The preferred surname appears on new ID documents, on request. Nothing obliges you to change it.
textes.Logement, comptes, impôts, CAF, enfants: Home, accounts, tax, CAF, children: what needs to change.
textes.Locataires : celui qui part donne congé: Tenants: the one leaving gives notice (their joint liability can last up to 6 months). Owners: sale, buying out the other's share or joint ownership, with the notary and the bank.
textes.Désolidarisez-vous du compte joint par l: Remove yourself from the joint account by letter to the bank, and review any shared loans.
textes.Dans « Gérer mon prélèvement à la source: In “Gérer mon prélèvement à la source” (manage your withholding tax). Each of you then files your own return.
textes.Les aides sont recalculées. En cas de pe: Benefits are recalculated. If there is child maintenance, financial intermediation (ARIPA) secures its payment.
textes.Résidence, droit de visite, pension : pa: Residence, visiting rights, maintenance: by written agreement, court-approved agreement or a family court judge's decision.
textes.Assurances, mutuelle, abonnements : sépa: Insurance, top-up health insurance, subscriptions: separate them
textes.Chaque contrat au nom de celui qui le ga: Each contract in the name of whoever keeps it; new address for whoever is leaving.
textes.Personnes du foyer, dépenses partagées :: People in the household, shared expenses: Lucien can work out who owes what to settle up.
textes.Les démarches de la première semaine, pu: The steps for the first week, then the first months, in order.
textes.Déclarer le décès en mairie: Register the death at the town hall
textes.Dans les 24 heures, à la mairie du lieu: Within 24 hours, at the town hall of the place of death, with the death certificate; funeral directors often take care of this.
textes.L'inhumation ou la crémation a lieu au p: Burial or cremation takes place no later than 14 days after the death. Costs can be partly paid from the deceased's account, on presentation of the invoice.
textes.Prévenir l'employeur, la banque et les c: Notify the employer, the bank and the pension and benefit funds
textes.Employeur ou caisses de retraite, banque: Employer or pension funds, bank (personal accounts are frozen), Assurance maladie, CAF, top-up health insurance.
textes.Le service AGIRA retrouve les contrats d: The AGIRA service tracks down life insurance contracts held by the deceased.
textes.Énergie, box, abonnements, assurance hab: Energy, broadband, subscriptions, home and car insurance: a death certificate is enough to cancel free of charge.
textes.Le notaire établit l'acte de notoriété e: The notary draws up the certificate of inheritance (acte de notoriété) and the estate declaration, to be filed within 6 months.
textes.Dans les 6 mois du décès (en France), sa: Within 6 months of the death (in France), except small estates exempt from filing.
textes.Impôts : déclaration des revenus du défu: Tax: return for the deceased's income
textes.Au printemps suivant, pour la période du: The following spring, for the period from 1 January to the date of death; the spouse or PACS partner reports the death within 60 days to adjust the withholding tax.
textes.Assurance, carte grise, vente de l'ancie: Insurance, vehicle registration, selling the old one: nothing forgotten.
textes.Assurer la voiture avant de rouler: Insure the car before driving it
textes.L'assurance au tiers au minimum est obli: At least third-party insurance is compulsory from the first drive. Shop around: after one year, the old contract can be cancelled at any time.
textes.Voiture d'occasion : changement de titul: Used car: change of owner within one month, online on the ANTS website. New car: the dealer often handles it.
textes.Contrôle technique de moins de 6 mois: Technical inspection less than 6 months old
textes.Pour une voiture d'occasion de plus de 4: For a used car more than 4 years old, the seller must provide it.
textes.Vendre l'ancienne : déclaration de cessi: Selling the old one: declaration of sale
textes.Le vendeur déclare la cession sur le sit: The seller declares the sale on the ANTS website within 15 days, and cancels the old vehicle's insurance as of the sale date.
textes.Obligatoire dans les zones à faibles émi: Compulsory in the low-emission zones of many cities. Order only on the official website.
textes.France Travail, mutuelle, aides, budget: France Travail, top-up health insurance, benefits, budget: the right first steps.
textes.Certificat de travail, attestation emplo: Employment certificate, employer's statement for France Travail, final settlement receipt. Keep them in Lucien.
textes.Dès le lendemain de la fin du contrat, e: From the day after the contract ends, online. Registration opens up your unemployment benefit rights, if you have any.
textes.La mutuelle et la prévoyance de l'entrep: Company top-up health insurance and provident cover are kept free of charge for as long as you receive unemployment benefit, up to 12 months.
textes.Prime d'activité, APL : déclarez le chan: Prime d'activité, APL: report the change in income.
textes.Lucien repère les abonnements à suspendr: Lucien spots subscriptions to pause and shows your end-of-month balance.
textes.Les droits acquis restent utilisables pe: The rights you have built up remain usable while you look for work.
textes.Prêt, assurance emprunteur, signature, p: Loan, borrower insurance, signing, then the move.
textes.Date de signature chez le notaire: Date of signing at the notary's
textes.Après la signature du compromis, l'achet: After the preliminary contract (compromis) is signed, the buyer has 10 days to withdraw. The loan is usually a condition of the sale.
textes.Lucien rassemble les pièces demandées pa: Lucien gathers the documents requested by the bank or broker.
textes.Vous pouvez choisir une autre assurance: You can choose a different insurer from the bank's, and switch at any time during the loan.
textes.Assurer le logement dès la remise des cl: Insure the home from the day you get the keys
textes.En copropriété, l'assurance responsabili: In a co-owned building, liability insurance is compulsory for the owner.
textes.Due par le propriétaire au 1er janvier ;: Owed by the owner on 1 January; the deed often provides for a pro rata reimbursement to the seller.
textes.Énergie, box, courrier, carte grise : Lu: Energy, broadband, mail, vehicle registration: Lucien follows on with the move.
textes.Bourse, logement, APL, assurance, impôts: Grant, housing, APL, insurance, tax: a smooth start to the academic year.
textes.À déposer entre mi-janvier et fin mai, s: To be submitted between mid-January and the end of May, without waiting for your placement.
textes.Résidence CROUS, colocation ou studio :: CROUS residence, flatshare or studio: Lucien prepares the rental application. The Visale guarantee can replace a guarantor.
textes.En ligne sur le site de la CAF dès l'ent: Online on the CAF website as soon as you move in.
textes.Obligatoire pour le locataire, dès la re: Compulsory for the tenant, from the day the keys are handed over.
textes.Contribution vie étudiante et de campus,: Student and campus life contribution (contribution vie étudiante et de campus), to be paid before administrative enrolment (grant holders are exempt).
textes.À la déclaration suivante : garder l'enf: At the next tax return: keep the child attached to the household, or detach them and deduct the maintenance paid. Lucien compares on the Family page.
textes.Relevé de carrière, demande unique, mutu: Career statement, single application, top-up health insurance: start six months ahead.
textes.Trimestres manquants, périodes à corrige: Missing quarters, periods to correct: get them fixed before applying.
textes.Une seule demande en ligne pour tous les: A single online application for all schemes, six months before your chosen date.
textes.Départ volontaire à la retraite : respec: Voluntary retirement: observe the notice required by law or the collective agreement.
textes.Mutuelle : garder sa couverture: Top-up health insurance: keep your cover
textes.En quittant la mutuelle d'entreprise, vo: When you leave the company top-up health insurance, you can ask to keep it individually within 6 months (loi Évin), or compare other policies.
textes.Pension plus basse que le salaire : sign: Pension lower than salary: report the drop in income in “Gérer mon prélèvement à la source” (manage your withholding tax).
textes.Déménagement, naissance, mariage, nouvel: Moving house, birth, marriage, new car… Lucien prepares each step, on the right date.
textes.Je suis locataire de mon logement actuel: I am a tenant in my current home
textes.En zone tendue (grandes villes : préavis: In a high-demand area (large cities: one month's notice)
textes.Chaque démarche s'ajoute à votre agenda: Each step is added to your Calendar on its date, with a reminder beforehand.
textes.Choisissez ce qui arrive et sa date : Lu: Choose what's coming up and its date: Lucien prepares each step in order, with the letters and files.
textes.Clore la situation retire de l'agenda le: Closing the situation removes the remaining steps from your Calendar.
textes.Capacité d'emprunt, comptes, dossier, as: Borrowing capacity, accounts, file, insurance, offer: the loan at the best price.
textes.Calculer votre capacité d'emprunt: Work out how much you can borrow
textes.Les banques limitent les mensualités de: Banks cap loan repayments at 35% of income, insurance included, over 25 years at most. Lucien works out your current debt ratio and what you have left to live on in Expert budget.
textes.La banque lit vos 3 derniers relevés : p: The bank reads your last 3 statements: no overdraft, regular saving, no needless subscriptions or revolving credit. Lucien spots what could make a bad impression.
textes.Pièces d'identité, bulletins de salaire,: ID, payslips, tax notice, statements, proof of deposit: Lucien gathers everything and flags what is missing or too old.
textes.Comparer les banques, ou passer par un c: Compare banks, or use a broker
textes.Taux, frais de dossier, garantie, assura: Rate, arrangement fees, guarantee, insurance, early repayment terms: compare at least three offers. A broker must be registered with ORIAS.
textes.Vous pouvez choisir une autre assurance: You can choose another insurer than the bank's, with equivalent cover. No health questionnaire if the insured share is under €200,000 per person and the loan ends before your 60th birthday.
textes.Caution d'un organisme spécialisé ou hyp: Surety from a specialist body or mortgage charge: costs and exit fees differ, ask for the details.
textes.Recevoir et accepter l'offre de prêt: Receive and accept the loan offer
textes.L'offre est envoyée par écrit et reste v: The offer is sent in writing and stays valid for 30 days. You can only accept it in writing after a full 10-day cooling-off period.
textes.Si l'achat est sous condition d'obtentio: If the purchase depends on getting the loan, tell the notary before the date set in the preliminary contract, with the offer or the banks' refusals.
textes.Les fonds sont versés au notaire (achat): Funds are paid to the notary (purchase) or against invoices (works).
textes.Ranger l'offre et le tableau d'amortisse: File the offer and the repayment schedule
textes.Lucien suit alors les mensualités dans l: Lucien then follows the repayments in the budget, the outstanding capital in the balance sheet, and the insurance anniversary.
textes.L'assurance emprunteur peut être changée: Loan insurance can be switched at any time, free of charge: shop around every year.
